title: Change address and contact details on a private mooring licence
summary: You can update the contact details on your private mooring licence online if you meet the eligibility requirements.
intro: If you want to update the contact details on your private mooring licence, you can do this online, provided you meet the eligibility requirement.
who_can_apply: Your current email address or mobile phone number must be recorded with Transport for NSW.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to change your contact details.

external_links.text: Boating and marine in NSW – Transport for NSW
Private mooring licence and rules – Transport for NSW

faqs.q: How can I update my contact details for my private mooring licence?
faqs.a: You can update your contact details online by selecting the 'Change online' button and following the prompts.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to change their contact details online?
faqs.a: You must have your current email address or mobile phone number recorded with Transport for NSW.
